body:
Dear friend,

Did you hear the rain in the night? Go and look at your bean row. Something is happening under the soil!

And on the bench by your door, I left little boards and a box of letters. Could you make name signs for the animals? Then everyone will know whose home is whose.
summary: Make name signs for the animals, and see what the rain did to your beans.
done: The animals have their name signs, and you saw the sprouts. Wonderful!

tasks.where: at the bench by your door
in her garden, by your beans
